items.source: The ReactiveSelectOperation.ReactiveSelect interface provides methods for constructing SELECT operations in a fluent way.
items.translation: `ReactiveSelectOperation.ReactiveSelect` 接口提供了以流式方式构建 `SELECT` 操作的方法。
